text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from accompanying
Nishino Flower on a shopping trip...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer-san!
Looks like they're holding it over there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, such wonderful prizes...!
Just like the greengrocer said!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
One lottery ticket, one single shot!
It's just like a race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The greengrocer she bought from earlier offered her 100 raffle tickets, but Nishino Flower politely declined.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you wanna give it a shot too, missy?
Let's pray you get something good!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Please...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower enthusiastically cranked the handle of the lottery machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Waaa~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I actually won the grand prize...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip, huh...
It feels kind of grown-up.
choice_data_list: It might be better to have your guardian with you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true.
I'm still just a child, after all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll try asking my mom and dad.
Um, and also...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Is this hot spring
okay for four people?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Should be totally fine, right?
I'll double-check later!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you so much!
Then you can come along too, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I haven't really been to hot springs much, but...
I get the impression that adults really love them.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
People who love it probably can't get enough of it, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right!
Is the hot spring here a nice place?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course.
Someone at my place is real picky about hot springs, and they gave this hidden bath an unconditional stamp of approval!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason
I want you to come with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I find a lovely place,
I want to go there together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, that is only
if you wouldn't mind it, though..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, because it's so much better
if you come along too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm begging you, absolutely please...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you should go with them!
They're asking you so earnestly, after all.

And so, I promised Nishino Flower
that we would go on a hot springs trip
once everything had settled down.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
What a super luxurious Salisbury steak!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hamburg steaks
are just so exciting, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! At my house, my mom would always make it for me as a reward whenever I got good test scores or won a race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I feel like hamburg steak
has a special kind of gentleness to it...
choice_data_list: So it's a taste filled with memories.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! What about you,
Trainer?

"I feel like I ate it on special days, but
also feel like I didn't. In the hustle and bustle
of daily life, my memories seem to have faded."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, then let's
share this hamburger steak!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This is a special Salisbury steak filled with the memory
of winning 1st prize in the lottery!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "And so, whenever something good happens from now on, I'll grill lots of Salisbury steaks!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, it doesn't have to be Salisbury steak.
I'll make whatever you like, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make some wonderfully sweet memories for us.
Let's make lots and lots of them from now on, okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah.
So many carrots...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Each one has a firm core,
and the root hairs are evenly spread.
They seem like they'll be plenty sweet, too♪
choice_data_list: You have a good eye, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I have a little bit of confidence in it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I helped out at home,
I was the one in charge of picking the ingredients♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever the supermarket folks praised me,
for some reason, my mom and dad
would get overjoyed...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...She gives me such a warm smile."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to see that smile...
...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Dad, Mom!
Can you see me okay...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, yay!
Trainer is taking a picture of me right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Did you get dinner ready?
It might be through a screen,
but let's eat together tonight...♪"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah, so cute...♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Sorry we didn't win anything.
You're not too disappointed, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine! After all,
it looks like such a delicious carrot!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"They're a bit small, but nice and red.
I bet they'll taste even better simmered...♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
do you have some time tonight?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's warm ourselves to the core with some carrot soup♪

That night was biting cold,
but Nishino Flower's homemade carrot soup
warmed both heart and body.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Auugh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I can immediately lend some
to anyone who doesn't have a tissue!

It seemed Nishino Flower wasn't feeling down
after all... or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... if we had won the grand prize,
Trainer would have been so happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I really wanted to hit it...
